what: References used by the shell obstacle course page, read from the engine-owned case file by wasm/check.mjs.
accuracyPolicy: Same strict 2% page policy as MacNeal–Harder; not a published tolerance. Existing native assertions are unchanged.

references.provenance: Inherited from shell_benchmark.rs. Equals the normalization value of MacNeal and Harder (1985), Table 5(a), p. 11 (theoretical value 0.3086 quoted there from Scordelis and Lo). Belytschko et al. (1985) tables not inspected.
Inherited from shell_benchmark.rs and solid_shell_locking.rs. Not checked against a published table here; Belytschko et al. (1985) tables not inspected.

Engine test convention of shell_benchmark.rs::benchmark_hemisphere_hole_convergence (quarter loads ±2). MacNeal and Harder (1985), Table 5(b), p. 11, normalize their loading by 0.0940; the conventions are not reconciled here. Belytschko et al. (1985) tables not inspected.
